annotation.title_clean: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan (PBIA)
annotation.title_en: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan (PBIA)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI); Center for Strategic Studies and Management (CGEE)
annotation.summary_en: Brazil's national AI plan (PBIA) by MCTI and CGEE commits R$23 billion through 2028 across five axes: infrastructure, training, public services, business innovation, and regulatory/governance support. It stresses human-centred, sovereign, sustainable and responsible AI. It has no robotics-specific provisions, only passing mention of autonomous mobility as high-risk.
key_provisions_or_claims: R$23.03 billion investment 2024-2028 across immediate-impact actions and five structuring axes
Five pillars of 'AI for the Good of All': human-centred, sustainable, sovereign, transparent/responsible, globally cooperative
Sovereign cloud and Portuguese-language LLM development
Federal Government AI Core to coordinate ethical AI adoption in public administration
Axis 5 supports regulatory and governance process, aligned with LGPD and ongoing regulatory initiatives
